notes: Final amendment (Amendment No. 2) for Eaton Vance Senior Income Trust (EVF) only. The attached press release (seq 2) reports results for four Eaton Vance tenders (EVG, EFT, EFR, EVF); only EVF's row is extracted, because this Schedule TO is EVF's. Results row columns: shares properly tendered, shares to be purchased, pro-ration factor, purchase price, shares outstanding after the tender (18,301,092.56). The table prints the EVF pro-ration factor as 'N/A' (undersubscribed); proration_factor_pct=100 comes from the statement that EVF 'will purchase all shares properly tendered', so a reviewer may prefer null. The final price $6.7897 is stated to be 99% of NAV at the close on July 30, 2021, the expiration date. trigger_origin activist_settlement is inferred from the exhibit list, which files a 'Standstill Agreement dated May 12, 2021' as exhibit (d)(i) to this Schedule TO; the filing does not say in words that the tender results from a settlement. commencement_date is the date of the Offer to Purchase and of the original Schedule TO filing (June 29, 2021). The fee table values the offer at 22,719,965 shares x $6.8234 (99% of NAV $6.8923 on June 23, 2021). No conditions are restated in this amendment.
